feedback.delta: Minimal HTTP+SQLite functionality has a concrete lowering witness using existing semantic categories; do not redesign core syntax yet. Add production APP-02/APP-03 vertical proof and typed DB transaction adapter receipts.
When H-WP-03 unblocks, include a real HTTP+DB vertical fixture with injected pre-commit failures and mutation detection; compare Reference vs Clay Harness semantic outcomes.

Logical transaction intent may remain semantically unified while SQLite stays a specialized physical adapter; persist transaction identity/outcome/rollback lineage without implying a physical monolith.
FRANK's logical UnifiedDB transaction/effect-gateway split is compatible with an adapter-realized HTTP+DB application slice; no FRANK architecture promotion and no self-Harness authority change.
HTTP/DB adapter realization does not change GWT selection/broadcast/causal-use semantics.
Database physical adapter behavior does not promote ClayGraph activation/association to truth or effect authority.
No new set-valued/topology semantics were required by this proxy.
Application lowering evidence is not emergence evidence.
General-purpose Clay may gain more by typed standard-library/host contracts than by adding domain-specific core syntax; test across HTTP, DB and GUI application families.
